name: Rhonabwy
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rhonabwy is a Welsh hero most notable for his skill at divination. In his dream he saw Arthur, and that vision came before Arthur took control.

okr.objective: Rhonabwy is a minor Welsh hero known for divination.
key_results: Rhonabwy is a Welsh minor hero.
He dreamed of king Arthur before Arthur took power.
